versions.short: The bill would allow nurse practitioners and physician assistants, within the scope of their practice under state law, to be treated as eligible providers under federal workers' compensation rules for injured federal employees. It would make conforming changes so these providers can be used in the same places physicians are currently referenced, such as in medical evidence and treatment provisions, and would change one provision to allow an additional physician rather than a third physician. It would also require the Secretary of Labor to finalize rules to carry out these changes within 6 months after enactment.
